name: Zangge Mining Company Limited
summary: Zangge Mining Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, researches, develops, manufactures, and sells potassium chloride and lithium carbonate in China and internationally. The company is also involved in mineral product development; investment activities; trade business; research and development of lithium extraction technology; and import and export of goods activities. In addition, it engages in the mining of copper, silver, and molybdenum deposits. The company was formerly known as Zangge Holding Company Limited and changed its name to Zangge Mining Company Limited in December 2021. Zangge Mining Company Limited was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Golmud, China.
